parse.title: The Fremennik Trials
parse.wikitext:
==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Brundt the Chieftain]] in the [[Rellekka]] longhall.
|startmap = 2658,3668
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = Council workmen have at last found the time to make repairs to the footbridge that connects Kandarin with the Barbarian town of Rellekka.

Do you have what it takes to impress the barbarians who live there, and perhaps be welcomed as an honorary member of their clan?
|length = Medium
|requirements = * Ability to defeat a level-69 [[Draugen]]
* Ability to defeat a [[Koschei|fairly strong warrior]] without [[armour]], [[weapons]], or [[spells]]
|items = * 5,252 [[coins]]
* [[Beer]] (obtainable during quest)
* [[Tinderbox]]
* Either a [[raw shark]], [[raw manta ray]], or [[raw sea turtle]]
* [[Lyre]], obtainable as a drop from [[Lanzig]], [[Borrokar]], [[Lensa]], or [[Freidir]], or the skills and materials to make one:
** {{SCP|Fletching|25|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Woodcutting|40|link=yes}}, and {{SCP|Crafting|40|link=yes}} (all [[boostable]])
** Woodcutting [[axe]]
** [[Knife]]
** [[Potato]] (obtainable during quest)
** [[Onion]] (obtainable during quest)
** [[Cabbage]] (obtainable during quest)
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|40|link=yes}}
* {{SCP|Agility|48|link=yes}} (when locating the [[Draugen]])
* [[Food]]
* [[Armour]] and a [[weapon]] ('''note:''' Ranged is '''not''' effective)
* 3-5 [[prayer potions]]
* [[Stamina potion]]s
* A [[super combat potion]] or [[super potion set|super set]]
* [[Camelot teleport]]
* [[Rellekka teleport]] or [[Teleport to House]] if your house is located in [[Rellekka]]
** [[Fairy ring]] {{fairycode|AJR}} or {{fairycode|CJR}} may also be used 
* 7 [[Ring of recoil|rings of recoil]] (only if attempting to defeat [[Koschei]]'s final form)
|kills = * [[Koschei the deathless]] (first three forms)
* [[Draugen]] ''(level 69)''
'''OPTIONAL'''
* [[Lanzig]], [[Borrokar]], [[Lensa]], or [[Freidir]] ''(level 48)'' (multiple times)
|ironman = * {{SCP|Fishing|76|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} is required to fish for [[raw shark]]s yourself, but there are multiple alternatives:
** [[Rufus' Meat Emporium]] in [[Canifis]] sells a single [[raw shark]].
** [[Frankie's Fishing Emporium]] in [[Port Piscarilius]] sells [[raw shark]].
** [[River troll]]s in the [[Enchanted Valley]] drop them commonly, but require access to [[fairy rings]].
** [[Waterfiend]]s, combat level 115, rarely drop noted [[raw shark]].
** [[Mogre]]s, combat level 60, require completion of [[Skippy and the Mogres]], {{SCP|Slayer|32|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}}, and [[fishing explosives]] to attack. They can rarely drop a [[raw shark]].
** [[Wintertodt]] can drop a [[raw shark]] after {{SCP|Fishing|43|link=yes}}, though it will be very rare, but chances increase with Fishing level. 
** [[Raw shark]] has a slight chance to drop from salvaging [[Barracuda salvage]].
* [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Sections of this quest have strict inventory requirements:
** [[#Thorvald the Warrior|Thorvald the Warrior]]: No weapons, armour, or runes. (A [[Looting bag]] is not allowed, regardless of its contents)
** [[#Peer the Seer|Peer the Seer]]: No items '''at all''' equipped or in your inventory.
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}
'''Note:''' If you start the quest, you will not be able to use [[Peer the Seer]] to bank your items, unless the player completes the easy [[Fremennik Diary|Fremennik Achievement Diary]] (requires completion of this quest), which re-enables his [[deposit box]] functionality. Before fighting Koschei the deathless, you are allowed to use the Peer the Seer to bank your forbidden items.
